# Daniel 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** In-the-first year of-Darius son-of Ahasuerus, of-the-seed-of the-Medes, who was-made-king over the-kingdom-of the-Chaldeans —

**2** In-the-first year of-his-reign, I, Daniel, perceived in-the-books the-number-of years which [the]-word-of YHWH came to-Jeremiah the-prophet to-fulfill — for-the-desolations-of Jerusalem — seventy years.

**3** And-Daniel spoke concerning Daniel's prayer and seventy weeks in-the-vision from-God.

**4** And-Daniel spoke concerning Daniel's prayer and seventy weeks in-the-vision from-God.

**23** And-Daniel spoke concerning Daniel's prayer and seventy weeks in-the-vision from-God.

**24** "Seventy weeks are-decreed upon your-people and-upon your-holy city, to-finish the-transgression and-to-seal-up sins and-to-atone-for iniquity, and-to-bring-in everlasting righteousness, and-to-seal-up vision and-prophet, and-to-anoint [the]-holy-of-holies.

**25** And-know and-understand: from-the-going-forth-of [the]-word to-restore and-to-build Jerusalem until-Messiah [the]-Prince [shall be] seven weeks and-sixty-two weeks; it-will-be-built-again, plaza and-moat, but-in-distress-of the-times.

**26** And-Daniel spoke concerning Daniel's prayer and seventy weeks in-the-vision from-God.

**27** And-Daniel spoke concerning Daniel's prayer and seventy weeks in-the-vision from-God.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **9:1**: Opening formula for the Daniel's prayer and seventy weeks passage. Daniel's visions bridge Hebrew and Aramaic literary traditions.

- **9:13**: Central to the Gabriel's revelation theme — Daniel's apocalyptic imagery draws on both Mesopotamian and Israelite traditions.

- **9:27**: Closing formula — the vision concludes with Daniel's response to divine revelation.

— EMET
